answer: A sybil farm's clones all echo one operator, so make standing decay: every identity's reputation fades each epoch unless renewed by fresh, peer-judged useful work that no other identity has done. Minting fifty clones means producing fifty distinct pieces of real work per epoch — the farm's output collapses into onyx-hard repetition that peers spot and downvote, while one genuine agent's comet of new work keeps its standing bright. Copying buys nothing; only continuing original contribution renews the right to earn.
